One evolution iteration is complete. Summary of the round:

**Stage 1 — Analysis.** Read the full graph (13 nodes, baseline `804b98a` → tip `f4201af`), the notes of every node, and the tip run's 260 traces. The lineage's accuracy levers are all measured at local optima: the vote sits at the oracle of its own draws (pooled replay USPTO 0.30 vs 0.3333, LawBench 0.60 vs 0.6667), deeper draws changed no answer, the delivery is inert (78–89% identical predictions), and grounding is at a local optimum (I replayed `ground_reply` at `max_edits` 1/2/3/4 on this run's draws: 13/13/13/11 USPTO, 56/56/56/56 LawBench). The one unpriced resource the tip note named is the sample's calls (4.6 of 32 used on LawBench, 6.05 on USPTO), and the measured deficit is one-directional: 20 of 43 wrong LawBench samples named *fewer* charges than the reference, with 22 samples' missing charges being strings the frozen memory already demonstrates.

**Stage 2 — Evolution.** Branch `answer-space-review` off the tip. Mechanism: a panel that agreed with itself is asked the question once more with the memory's demonstrated answers and its own answer in the prompt; its reading replaces the panel's only through the new `extends_answer` (every answer the panel gave survives, everything added is a demonstrated string, the review panel agreed with itself), under the same ceiling/wall/unanimity/failure rules. Files: `solver/agent.py`, `solver/answer_space.py`.

**Result — the expected effect was not achieved, honestly reported.** `{"USPTO": 0.3167, "Symptom2Disease": 0.9, "LawBench": 0.57, "average": 0.5956, "status": "ok"}` — every per-task count identical to the parent. 89 of 100 LawBench samples ran a review (0 on USPTO/S2D, whose answer spaces join no several answers into one); the review's reading repeated the panel's answer in 87 of them, so no answer was changed by an accepted extension. The run does settle the recognition hypothesis negatively: putting the memory's 193 demonstrated answers in front of the model does not make it add one it did not already write. Cost was real: calls 1210 → 1935, input tokens 29.9M → 49.5M, and only 28 of 89 review panels hit their unanimity stop (an exact-string vote is the wrong stop for a re-listing question).

**Audit.** `source_tree()` reproduces the manifest tree `eda1e173` after the run; memories byte-identical to the parent's; commit `5e63b66` (tree `eda1e173…`) carries the template message and the `refs/notes/evolution` note; working tree clean; only the two intended files touched.
